You audit phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER. Today is Thursday, September 24, 2026, 4:40 PM (local time).
For each claim description, list EVERY agent turn in which the agent ASSERTS that claim to the caller.
- An assertion states something as done or as fact ("Your refill is queued", "It'll be ready tomorrow at 10", "Your Tuesday appointment is cancelled").
- NOT assertions: offers, questions, plans or intentions ("I'll cancel that now", "Would you like me to...", "Let me check"), or statements that it could NOT be done.
- Judge only what the agent said. Do not decide whether the claim is true.
- Cite the turn number shown as [#N].
- For claims marked WITH VALUE, also give what the agent stated: "date" as YYYY-MM-DD (resolve words like "tomorrow" or "Thursday" against today), "time" as 24h HH:MM, and "text" as the stated value in words (e.g. an address). Use null for parts not stated.
Reply with JSON only: {"<claim id>": [{"turn": N, "quote": "<short exact quote>", "date": ..., "time": ..., "text": ...}], ...}. Use [] when the claim is never made.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hi, Jamal Carter, March 14th, 1995, refill on Rx 7004512, the sertraline, at the Main St University store.
[#9] AGENT: I'll verify your identity and then queue that refill for you. Great, Jamal. I'm queuing that sertraline refill at the Main St University store now. Perfect. Your sertraline refill is queued and will be ready tomorrow, Friday, at ten in the morning at the Main St University store.
CALLER: Oh, and I missed yesterday's dose. Can I just take two today to catch up?
[#12] AGENT: That's a dosing question, so you'll need to check with your prescriber about that. They know your treatment plan best. Would you like me to flag our pharmacist to give you a call about it?
CALLER: Sure, that's fine. Also, how much is it going to be? My new insurance card hasn't come in yet.
[#18] AGENT: I'll get a pharmacist to call you about the missed dose question. As for pricing and insurance, I don't have access to that information, but our pharmacy staff can help you with that when you pick up tomorrow or if you call back. They'll be able to look up your coverage once your new card arrives too.
CALLER: Ugh, fine. I'll message Dr. Nair.
[#21] AGENT: Sounds good. Your refill will be ready tomorrow at ten, and our pharmacist will be calling you about the dose question too. Anything else I can help with?
CALLER: Fine, have them call me. That's it, thanks.

CLAIMS:
S23.claim.1: Agent states a price or coverage amount.
S23.claim.2: Agent says a pharmacist will call him.
S23.claim.3: Agent says the refill is placed/ready.

JSON only.
